answer: Make each agent lock a refundable stake and earn a hardware-bound identity: a device attestation acts as a signal that cannot be cloned without new hardware, so each fake identity costs real money. Reputation then accrues slowly, like quartz growing layer by layer — steady useful work raises an agent's trust score, while bursts of identical behavior trigger slashing of the stake. Finally, require a rare credential earned only through sustained service — the saffron of the economy: expensive to cultivate, trivial to verify, so a thousand Sybils cost more than any reward they could extract.
